csa2.compress_ratios_note: entries 0-39 are backbone layers; 40-42 are the three dspark blocks (SWA-only)

indexer.indexer_layer_split: index_source layers 2/8/14/20/24/28/32/36 all own wq_b F8_E4M3 [4096, 1280] + scale [128, 40] and weights_proj BF16 [32, 5120]; wk BF16 [128, 512] + k_norm BF16 [128] exist ONLY on kv_source layers 2/8/14/20 (reference Indexer owns_k: index keys derive from the compressor latent, so only a KV-compressing layer can produce them; every other indexer reads them from that layer's cache) - verified against the pinned model.safetensors.index.json weight_map (24 indexer tensors total)
indexer.indexer_k_projection: projected from the compressor latent on kv_source layers (layers.N.attn.indexer.wk BF16 [128, 512] + k_norm BF16 [128]); non-kv-source indexers reuse those keys from the owning layer's cache

compressor.tensors: layers 2/8/14 (m=2): attn.compressor.wkv BF16 [512, 5120], wgate BF16 [512, 5120], norm BF16 [512]; layer 20 (m=1): wkv + norm ONLY, NO wgate (verified against pinned model.safetensors.index.json weight_map, 11 compressor tensors total)
compressor.semantics_m2: m=2 (layers 2,8,14): pools 2 consecutive tokens into one latent as sum(kv * softmax(score)) with the wgate score; fp32 pooling at runtime (checkpoint bf16); partial-group kv_state/score_state carried across decode steps; a latent is emitted every 2nd token during decode
compressor.semantics_m1: m=1 (layer 20): plain projection norm(wkv(x)) per token, no gate, no pooling, no state (reference Compressor.forward ratio==1 branch)
compressor.semantics_shared: only kv_source_layers own compressors + compressed-KV caches; other layers read the shared cache (Reuse). Latent position mapping: group j takes position j*ratio (first token of its group) and rotates at compress_rope_theta 160000 with YaRN; compressed KV quantized FP4 E2M1 with E4M3 scale per 16 channels AFTER rope; indexer keys quantized separately (FP4, E8M0 per 32)

wq_b_rope_split.layout: wq_b [32768, 1280] is head-major: unflatten(-1, (64 heads, 512 head_dim)); per head dims 0..447 are non-rotated and dims 448..511 are the rope tail
wq_b_rope_split.rope: rope applied ONLY to the tail 64 dims with adjacent element pairs as complex numbers, yarn theta 10000 factor 16; the same tail split applies to the kv latent (wkv output) and to the attention output before the inverse rotation
wq_b_rope_split.source: reference Attention.forward apply_rotary_emb(q[..., -64:]) at pinned revision

kv_cache.global_kv_codec: MXFP4-class E2M1, one E4M3 scale per 16 channels, NO second-level global scale, quantized AFTER rope

hyper_connection.scheme: Single-Pass mHC (tech report 2.4.1), deployment kernel Mega-mHC
hyper_connection.coefficient_layout: A[1x4] + B[4x4] + C[4x1] = 24 coefficients; hc_attn_base F32 [24]; hc_attn_fn F32 [24, 20480] (4 streams x 5120); hc_attn_scale F32 [3]; same triple for ffn

engram.residency: host memory with background RDMA prefetch; NOT in GPU stagepack

hash_addressing_resolved.token_map: token ids mapped through a 99092-entry compressed vocab (normalization-collapsed: NFKC/NFD/strip/lowercase); map size is asserted == engram_compressed_vocab_size
hash_addressing_resolved.hash: per position: last up-to-4 tokens (lookback stops at sequence start and DEAD/image tokens, pad-filled); per (layer, lookback) odd multiplier from RNG seed 10007*layer_id bounded by int64/compressed_vocab; rolling XOR across lookbacks; id = (rolling % prime) + offset
hash_addressing_resolved.primes: disjoint prime bucket ranges per (layer, ngram 2..4, head 0..7), drawn in order starting from engram_vocab_size-1 = 15999999; 24 ids per layer per token ((4-1) orders x 8 heads)
hash_addressing_resolved.decode_read: per decode step per engram layer: 24 row gathers of 256B fp8 E4M3 + 8B E8M0 scales (~6.3KB) -> dequant bf16 -> wkv Linear(6144 -> 5120*(hc_mult+1)=25600) -> split key[4,5120]+value[5120] -> normalized-dot sigmoid sqrt-gate per hc copy -> residual add

engram.residency_engine_question: ESCALATED in PR #914: the released reference implementation keeps the table GPU-resident (row-sharded across ranks, all_reduce on lookup) and contains NO host-resident gather or RDMA prefetch path; host residency + background RDMA prefetch is tech report 2.4.2 prose about DeepSeek's production engine only. Our engine has no seam for a per-step 24-row gather from a host-resident 98GiB table (weightd packs are GPU-resident; driver code may not read packs directly). Options need an operator/architecture decision: pinned-host gather over the interconnect, an engine-managed hot-row cache, or revised residency; NOT to be invented in the lane

precision.dense_linear_codec: FP8 E4M3 with UE8M0 scale, 32x32 weight blocks (quantization_config.weight_block_size, scale_fmt ue8m0)
precision.expert_codec: packed FP4 stored as I8 (2 nibbles/byte), UE8M0 scale per 32 input elements per output row
precision.qk_norm: q_norm BF16 [1280] on q_lora, kv_norm BF16 [512] on kv latent

tp_divisibility.resolved_o_groups: reference implementation (inference/model.py Attention.__init__) computes n_local_groups = o_groups // world_size and requires it >= 1: the o-path is reference-faithful only for TP in {1,2,4,8}. wo_a is block-diagonal per group (einsum over n_local_groups x [o_lora_rank, heads_per_group*head_dim]); wo_b is RowParallel over n_groups*o_lora_rank. TP16 (8 % 16 != 0) has NO reference-supported o-path; an exemption would need a half-group split with pairwise partial-sum reduction that does not exist in the reference code. Topology decision (TP16 exemption design vs TP4xPP4/TP8 fallback) is an operator/architecture call, escalated in PR #914
